 Deals and Sales Wayfair’s fall Way Day sale is back, with up to 84% off furniture, storage, appliances and more 
 Take advantage of the retailer’s best deals of the year ahead of the holidays. Oct. 24, 2026, 6:00 AM EDT Cory Fernandez
 Commerce Editor
 Shop must-haves like storage cabinets, mattresses, and kitchenware Wayfair Wayfair’s annual Way Day sale is finally here, and it has some of the retailer’s best deals on highly-reviewed home storage , organization , furniture , appliances and much more, with discounts reaching all the way up to 84% off. 
 Way Day is like Wayfair’s equivalent to Amazon Prime Day or Target Circle Deal Days (previously Target Circle Week), which means it has some of the best deals of the entire year. The sale officially starts on Saturday Oct. 24 and runs through Monday Oct. 26. Below, I rounded up some of the best deals to grab before it’s over.
 Selected. Our top picks 
 Best overall deal Household Essentials Jumbo Storage Box (Set of 2) $26.97 $42.99 Wayfair Learn more 
 Best storage deal Bay Isle Home Clie 16-Pair Shoe Storage Cabinet $102.99 $199.99 Wayfair Learn more 
 Best appliance deal Roborock Qrevo S5V Robot Vacuum Cleaner $499.99 $899.99 Wayfair Learn more

 Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. 
 The best Way Day deals to shop this weekend 
 Below, I rounded up some of the best deals from Wayfair’s Way Day sale, all of which have at least a four-star average rating from 100 reviews or more at Wayfair and are at least 20% off. 
 Household Essentials Jumbo Storage Box (Set of 2) 
 $ 26.97 $ 42.99 Wayfair Now 37% off This set comes with two collapsible fabric storage boxes, each of which comes with a lid and has a 15-pound weight capacity. The boxes have handles on either side for easy maneuvering and they’re the perfect size for storing extra clothing, accessories, shoes and other personal items. Shoppers say they love how durable the bins are and that they’re confident they’ll last a long time. 
 Bay Isle Home Clie 16-Pair Shoe Storage Cabinet 
 $ 102.99 $ 199.99 Wayfair Now 49% off This shoe storage cabinet holds up to 16 pairs of shoes, including heels and short boots. Plus, the cabinet doubles as a small entryway table that’s ideal for small apartments. There’s room on top to rest your keys and other small items you typically grab on your way out. Each of the two cabinet doors opens out so that you can see all the shoes in them at once, and the shelves are adjustable, so you can remove one of them to allow for shoes of different sizes, according to the brand.
 Roborock Qrevo S5V Robot Vacuum Cleaner 
 $ 499.99 $ 899.99 Wayfair Now 44% off This popular robot vacuum picks up dust, dirt and pet hair and also wet mops your floors. It has a self-emptying function, navigation technology that prevent it from running into furniture and other stationery objects and it has an extendable mop pad that cleans around corners. The vacuum is also controllable via an app, so you can schedule to clean at different times, even when you’re not home.
 Beachcrest Home Manhattan Storage Cabinet 
 $ 75.99 $ 109.99 Wayfair Now 31% off This storage cabinet is perfect for holding home essentials, especially in your bathroom or laundry room. The interior has two shelves of storage to house soap, disinfectant sprays and more, and four small drawers on the side are great for keeping toilet paper, detergent pods, hand towels and more. It’s available in a slightly larger size for homes that have the space and shoppers say that it’s easy to put together. 
 Red Barrel Studio Over-the-toilet Storage Cabinet 
 $ 82.99 $ 150.89 Wayfair Now 45% off If you have a small bathroom, vertical storage is the way to go, and this over-the-toilet storage unit is perfect for holding essentials. It’s around 66 inches tall and fits over toilets that are just under 32 inches high. It has three shelves, two of which are covered by doors that let you tuck away the things you don’t want on display. This is a great storage unit for holding toilet paper and grooming products, plus decor like photos and small plants that add a nice touch to any bathroom. 
 Willa Arlo Interiors Dunphy Upholstered Platform Bed 
 $ 174.99 $ 1,080.99 Wayfair Now 84% off The 83% discount on this bed won’t last forever, so if you’re in the market for a new bed, you should jump on this quickly. It comes in several colors and, according to the brand, is easy to assemble. The standout is easily the adjustable headboard and built-in slat system, which means you can use a mattress of any height and skip the box spring.
 Bedsure Comforter Set 
 $ 46.99 $ 209.97 Wayfair Now 78% off $ 36.99 $ 41.99 Amazon Now 12% off $ 47.99 Bedsure This quilt set from Bedsure is perfect if you’re planning to change your bedding for the fall and winter seasons. It’s available in several colors and it comes in twin, queen and king mattress sizes (though sizes may be limited in some colors). The set includes a reversible, lightweight comforter and two pillow shams. The bedding is made of soft microfiber and is machine washable. 
 Keurig K-Elite Single-Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker 
 $ 123.99 $ 203.99 Wayfair Now 39% off $ 139.99 $ 209.99 Target Now 33% off $ 139.99 $ 209.99 Amazon Now 33% off This single-serve coffee maker brews 4-, 6-, 8-, 10- and 12-ounce cups of coffee in just a minute, according to the brand. It also has a button to adjust the strength of the brew and it has a descaling function when it’s time to clean it. It’s programmable so you can schedule it to start at a particular time, which is helpful if you want a hot cup waiting for you when you get up in the morning. 
 Kingstone 60-Piece Flatware Set 
 $ 101.99 $ 139.99 Wayfair Now 27% off If you plan on doing some entertaining over the holidays and will be serving meals, this flatware set could be a great way to make sure you don’t run out of forks and all. Each piece is dishwasher safe and they’re all made of rust-resistant stainless steel, according to the brand.
 Staub Cast Iron Round Dutch Oven Hand Crafted In France 
 $ 299.99 $ 514.00 Wayfair Now 42% off $ 299.95 $ 470.00 Williams-Sonoma Now 36% off $ 299.96 $ 671.00 Sur La Table Now 55% off Staub makes some of the best Dutch ovens available, and this popular one comes in multiple colors. It is made of cast iron but has an enamel coating and you don’t have to season it. It’s safe to put in the oven up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit and has handles on each side that make it easy to transfer the hefty pot from the oven to the table or counter.

 What is Way Day?
 Way Day is Wayfair’s multi-day sale event that happens twice a year: once in the spring and once in the fall. The sale includes the best deals of the year, which are expected to be as much as 80% off this fall. Way Day is comparable to other major sale events, like Amazon Prime Day and Target Circle Deal Days, but it doesn’t typically take place alongside those sales, which often happen at the same time. 
 The sale includes deals on small and large furniture, storage, mattresses, sofas, organization, home and kitchen appliances and more. Plus, it will have deals on in-house labels like Latitude Run , Wade Logan and Sand & Stable , as well as name brands like Bissell , Phillips , Serta and many more. Additionally, there will be substantial deals from Wayfair’s partner retailers Joss & Main and AllModern . 
 When is Wayfair’s fall Way Day sale 2026?
 Wayfair’s fall Way Day sale is happening Saturday, Oct. 24 and runs until Monday, Oct. 26. Though the sale officially starts this weekend, the retailer kicked off early deals and flash deals on Monday, Oct. 19.
 What is worth shopping from the Way Day sale?
 While Wayfair often has many sales throughout the year, Way Day includes some of the best deals, particularly on storage and organization items like shoe cabinets, storage bins, closet organizers and more. Additionally, the sale includes deals on highly reviewed sofas and mattresses, so if you’re moving into a new place or want to refresh your furniture before the end of the year, this is a great opportunity to do it. 
 Lastly, since it’s October, now is a great time to shop any and everything related to the holidays, including gifts , holiday party essentials and more.
 Why trust NBC Selected?
 I’m a commerce editor at NBC Selected, where I write about home and kitchen appliances, organization, storage, furniture, home decor and more. I’ve covered Wayfair’s Way Day sale multiple times in the past as well as similar sales from Home Depot, Target and Lowe’s.
